aiResearchSummary.text: Shiru is researching structured protein particulates in fiber or sheet form that form oleogels and macrocolloids with improved thickening and stabilizing properties, as described in a disclosure on protein dry particulates. Another area involves climate change mitigation using oleogels prepared from plant proteins dispersed in oil phases. Additionally, Shiru is developing systems for identifying and developing food ingredients from natural sources using machine learning and in silico processes.
